```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML, display

import _helpers as h
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
dmps = h.load_dmps()
erbs = h.load_erbs()

dept_data = {}
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    dd = h.filter_department(dmps, dept)
    de = h.department_erbs(dd, erbs)
    dept_data[dept] = {"dmps": dd, "erbs": de}
```

## DMPs per department

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Total

> **Overview.** How many Data Management Plans (DMPs) has each department produced?

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    df = h.approval_by_department(pdf)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="DMPs", y="Department", orientation="h",
                 text="DMPs", color="DMPs", color_continuous_scale="Blues")
    fig.update_layout(yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
                      coloraxis_showscale=False, height=500)
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

### By purpose

> **Overview.** How many Data Management Plans (DMPs) has each department produced, split by **purpose** — scientific vs. educational research?


## Compliance


### Approval by department

> **Q1.** What share of research projects have an **approved Data Management
> Plan (DMP)**, broken down **per department**?

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    df = h.approval_by_department(pdf)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Approval rate", y="Department", orientation="h",
                 text=df["Approval rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0%}"),
                 hover_data=["DMPs", "Approved"], color="Approval rate",
                 color_continuous_scale="Blues")
    fig.update_layout(yaxis={"categoryorder": "total ascending"},
                      xaxis_tickformat="0%", coloraxis_showscale=False, height=500)
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

### Archive location

> **Q6.** What share of projects **archive their data at the TU/e archive
> (RAPS)**?

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    df = h.archive_breakdown(pdf)
    total = df["DMPs"].sum() or 1
    df = df.assign(Share=df["DMPs"] / total, All="All DMPs")
    df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="All", y="DMPs", color="Location", text="Label")
    fig.update_traces(textposition="auto")
    fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="", yaxis_title="DMPs", height=500,
                      barmode="stack", showlegend=True, legend_title="Location")
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

## Data handling {.tabset}

### Storage

> **Q3.** To what extent do projects use **TU/e secured storage**, and
> conversely, what share of **sensitive research data** is stored **outside**
> TU/e-supported solutions?

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    df = h.storage_split(pdf)
    total = df["DMPs"].sum() or 1
    df = df.assign(Share=df["DMPs"] / total, All="All DMPs")
    df["Label"] = df.apply(lambda r: f'{r["DMPs"]} ({r["Share"]:.0%})', axis=1)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="All", y="DMPs", color="Category", text="Label")
    fig.update_traces(textposition="auto")
    fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="", yaxis_title="DMPs", height=500,
                      barmode="stack", showlegend=True, legend_title="Storage")
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

### Days to first submission

> **Q8.** How long elapses between **DRAFT and SUBMITTED** (ideally pre-computed
> as `days_to_first_submission`)?

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pdf in [("all", dmps_all), ("scientific", dmps_sci), ("educational", dmps_edu)]:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    s = h.days_to_first_submission(pdf).dropna()
    fig = px.histogram(s, nbins=40, labels={"value": "Days"})
    fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Days", yaxis_title="DMPs", height=500, showlegend=False,
                      annotations=[dict(text=f"Median: {s.median():.0f} days | Mean: {s.mean():.1f} days",
                      xref="paper", x=0.98, yref="paper", y=0.98, xanchor="right", showarrow=False)])
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById("dept-select");
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".dept-panel");
  function show(slug) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
    var target = document.getElementById("dept-" + slug);
    if (target) target.style.display = "";
  }
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var init = params.get("dept");
  if (init) { sel.value = init; show(init); }
  else { show(sel.value); }
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    show(this.value);
    params.set("dept", this.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
  });

  var purposeToggle = document.querySelector(".purpose-toggle");
  if (purposeToggle) {
    var pBtns = purposeToggle.querySelectorAll(".purpose-btn");
    var pPanels = document.querySelectorAll(".purpose-content");
    function showPurpose(p) {
      pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.purpose === p); });
      pPanels.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.toggle("purpose-active", el.dataset.purpose === p); });
    }
    pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { showPurpose(this.dataset.purpose); }); });
    showPurpose("all");
  }
});
</script>
